ai1.model: LightGBM + isotonic + Mondrian conformal + robust novelty

model_selection.reason: catboost had the highest mean CV PR-AUC, but the paired difference vs LightGBM (+0.0076, 95% CI +0.0020 to +0.0132) is not clearly better (margin 0.01). LightGBM is kept for exact TreeSHAP reasons and faster serving.

thresholds.rule: chosen on the validation split: amber = 5% / red = 1% of normal transfers flagged

ai3.event: balance below Tk 200 at the end of the next 7 days
ai3.probability_method: empirical normalised residuals of the 7-day sum (calibrated on validation origins)
ai3.threshold_rule: best F1 on validation within an alert budget (configs/thresholds.yaml)
ai3.baseline: historical frequency of low balance (training window)

ai4.event: cash-out demand above the agent's cash on hand on that day
ai4.capacity_rule: agent_capacity_factor x mean daily demand in the training window [ASSUMPTION]
ai4.probability_method: empirical normalised residuals (calibrated on validation origins)
ai4.threshold_rule: best F2 on validation within an alert budget (configs/thresholds.yaml)

action_rule_test.rule: top up when the 90% forecast exceeds cash on hand

ai4.baseline: historical stock-out frequency per agent and weekday (training window)

ai5.model: 70% LightGBM (uses same-size peer-comparison features) + 30% IsolationForest (rank fusion); the peer z-score alone is the transparent baseline
ai5.fee_leakage_note: estimated potential fee leakage under an UNVERIFIED synthetic fee assumption, not a real figure

fee_rate_assumption.note: [ASSUMPTION] placeholder; a Sept 2026 press report mentions Tk 12-18 per cash-out - check the unit/basis before quoting.

thresholds.rule: validation split: amber = 10%, red = 2% of honest merchant-weeks flagged

ai6.method: time-respecting path tracing (<=3 hops, <=48h) + union-find linking + transparent chain score; Louvain communities for ring discovery

brief.bangla: কিছু সতর্ক সংকেত। Highest AI-1 scam probability among linked transfers: 0.17। 1 customer sent money into the same wallet chain। 100% of the money moved on within 48 hours। সিস্টেম নিশ্চিত নয়, তাই একজন কর্মী যাচাই করবেন।
brief.english: Some warning signs. Highest AI-1 scam probability among linked transfers: 0.17. 1 customer sent money into the same wallet chain. 100% of the money moved on within 48 hours. The system is not sure, so a person will check. You can: review the linked transfers, request merchant sale evidence, decide on any hold (human approval required).
